title: 明潭抽蓄水力發電廠
summary: 以上下池、可逆機組與往返效率解析明潭抽蓄水力發電廠：六個原理與架構單元、十二項可保存的分析及驗證作業，附假想量化例、來源及衍生工程比較。
summaryEn: Explore Mingtan Pumped Storage Power Plant through upper/lower pools, reversible units and round-trip efficiency: six principle/architecture units and twelve saved analysis/validation tasks, with an assumed numerical example, primary sources and related engineering comparisons.
scope: 和平民用發電與融合研究的公開熱循環、功能架構及工程證據。核能不包含燃料製備、濃縮、武器、反應性整定或反應爐操作；地熱、風電及水力不提供未經場址驗證的施工／操作參數。算例皆是假想，實機由合格專業團隊依規範負責。
scopeEn: Public thermal cycles, functional architecture and engineering evidence for peaceful generation/fusion research. Nuclear content excludes fuel production, enrichment, weapons, reactivity settings and reactor operations. Geothermal/wind/hydro supply no unverified construction/operation settings. Examples are hypothetical; qualified professionals govern actual equipment.
v30Focus: 以日月潭為上池的 1,602 MW 抽蓄電廠與運轉型態的轉變
v30FocusEn: A 1,602 MW pumped-storage plant using Sun Moon Lake as upper reservoir, and its changing duty

stages.title: 系統邊界與基本原理
stages.description: 在明潭抽蓄水力發電廠案例中比較上下池淨水頭與可逆水輪pump，各完成分析及驗證。
stages.descriptionEn: Analyze and validate pool net head and reversible turbine/pump within the Mingtan Pumped Storage Power Plant case.

steps.title: 水頭流量與能量：架構分析
steps.titleEn: Head, flow and energy: architecture analysis
steps.objective: 針對上下池淨水頭提出可反駁的水頭流量與能量模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable head, flow and energy model and evidence record for pool net head.
steps.instruction: 在「明潭抽蓄水力發電廠」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識上下池淨水頭。有效水頭與流量共同給出水力功率；高程差需扣除流動損失。 建立水頭流量與能量的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是上下池、可逆機組與往返效率。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。覈對rho g Q H與效率及單位。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
steps.instructionEn: Identify pool net head in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Mingtan Pumped Storage Power Plant. Effective head/flow define hydraulic power; elevation differences need flow-loss corrections. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of head, flow and energy, focusing on upper/lower pools, reversible units and round-trip efficiency. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Check rho g Q H, efficiencies and units. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.
steps.observation: 覈對rho g Q H與效率及單位。
steps.observationEn: Check rho g Q H, efficiencies and units.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：壩高等於每個工況的淨水頭。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Dam height equals net head in every operating condition.
steps.check: 提交上下池淨水頭的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。
steps.checkEn: Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for pool net head.

knowledge.title: 水頭流量與能量
knowledge.text: 有效水頭與流量共同給出水力功率；高程差需扣除流動損失。 本課架構對應：上下池淨水頭
knowledge.textEn: Effective head/flow define hydraulic power; elevation differences need flow-loss corrections. Course architecture correspondence: Pool net head

knowledge.title: 獨立驗證與失效邊界
knowledge.text: 覈對rho g Q H與效率及單位。 應逐項保留基準與不確定度；壩高等於每個工況的淨水頭。 是本單元要排除的誤解。
knowledge.textEn: Check rho g Q H, efficiencies and units. Retain each reference and uncertainty; reject the misconception: Dam height equals net head in every operating condition.

knowledge.title: 原創假想量化練習
knowledge.text: 假設淨水頭60 m、流量7 m³/s、效率0.88，P=1000×9.81×7×60×0.88=3.625776 MW。另若抽蓄上下流程效率均0.88，往返效率0.7744；高程、流量皆是假想，非場站規格。
knowledge.textEn: Assume net head 60 m, flow 7 m³/s and efficiency 0.88: P=3.625776 MW. Two pumped-cycle legs at 0.88 yield round-trip efficiency 0.7744. Inputs are assumed, not plant specifications.

knowledge.title: 任務延伸｜遊戲交班延伸：先界定介面
knowledge.titleEn: Mission extension | Campaign transfer: define interfaces first
knowledge.text:
本課「明潭抽蓄水力發電廠」的「水頭流量與能量：架構分析」是這項延伸任務的檢核點。 畫出能源輸入、轉換、儲存、輔助負載與有用輸出的邊界，在每條箭頭旁寫量、單位、正方向與資料版本。再打開「能源站：把損失算回來」，比較哪一個介面可類比、哪一個不可類比；不可因為畫面相似就共用數值參數。

需留下的證據：提交一張介面圖與同時間窗的能源表、儲能狀態、損失項及設備範圍的欄位樣本；將假設值、來源值與本次實測值分欄。

驗證與交接：每個介面至少有一個可核對量；提出一項能讓模型失效的邊界改變，而不是只重述公式。
knowledge.textEn:
The checkpoint is “Head, flow and energy: architecture analysis” in “Mingtan Pumped Storage Power Plant”. Draw the energy input, conversion, storage, auxiliary loads and useful-output boundaries; label quantities, units, sign conventions and data revisions on each arrow. Open “Energy Station: Account for the Losses” and identify which interfaces transfer and which do not. Similar-looking scenes do not justify shared numerical parameters.

Evidence to retain: Submit an interface diagram and sample fields for same-window energy accounts, storage state, loss terms and equipment boundary, separating assumed, sourced and newly measured values.

Verification and handover: Each interface has a checkable quantity. Identify one boundary change that invalidates the model instead of merely repeating a formula.

quiz.question: 就上下池淨水頭的「水頭流量與能量」，哪個推論或驗證成立？
quiz.questionEn: Which inference or check is justified for head, flow and energy in pool net head?
options: 有效水頭與流量共同給出水力功率；高程差需扣除流動損失。
壩高等於每個工況的淨水頭。
兩個案例的平均相同，就足以排除空間、時間及模型誤差。
optionsEn: Effective head/flow define hydraulic power; elevation differences need flow-loss corrections.
Dam height equals net head in every operating condition.
Equal case averages rule out spatial, temporal and model errors.
quiz.explanation: 有效水頭與流量共同給出水力功率；高程差需扣除流動損失。 覈對rho g Q H與效率及單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Effective head/flow define hydraulic power; elevation differences need flow-loss corrections. Check rho g Q H, efficiencies and units.

steps.title: 水頭流量與能量：證據驗證
steps.titleEn: Head, flow and energy: evidence validation
steps.objective: 針對上下池淨水頭提出可反駁的水頭流量與能量模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable head, flow and energy model and evidence record for pool net head.
steps.instruction: 沿用前一步「水頭流量與能量」模型，檢查上下池淨水頭的兩個假想案例。覈對rho g Q H與效率及單位。 先訂可接受誤差，再比較預測與獨立計算；區分有效水頭與流量共同給出水力功率；高程差需扣除流動損失。與另一個可能造成相同輸出的機制。保存輸入、殘差、不確定度及採信／保留理由。缺少公開資料就標示尚未驗證，不補造產品數字。
steps.instructionEn: Use the previous head, flow and energy model to inspect two hypothetical cases involving pool net head. Check rho g Q H, efficiencies and units. Set acceptable error before comparing predictions with an independent calculation. Distinguish "Effective head/flow define hydraulic power; elevation differences need flow-loss corrections." from an alternative cause with similar output. Save inputs, residuals, uncertainty and accept/hold reasoning. Mark absent public evidence as unverified rather than inventing product values.
steps.observation: 覈對rho g Q H與效率及單位。
steps.observationEn: Check rho g Q H, efficiencies and units.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：壩高等於每個工況的淨水頭。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Dam height equals net head in every operating condition.
steps.check: 提交上下池淨水頭的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。
steps.checkEn: Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for pool net head.

steps.title: 水輪機與工況：架構分析
steps.titleEn: Turbines and operating envelopes: architecture analysis
steps.objective: 針對可逆水輪pump提出可反駁的水輪機與工況模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable turbines and operating envelopes model and evidence record for reversible turbine/pump.
steps.instruction: 在「明潭抽蓄水力發電廠」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識可逆水輪pump。Francis、Kaplan與Pelton適合不同水頭流量；離設計點效率與空蝕風險會變。 建立水輪機與工況的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是上下池、可逆機組與往返效率。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。比較假想效率地圖而非只取最高效率點。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
steps.instructionEn: Identify reversible turbine/pump in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Mingtan Pumped Storage Power Plant. Francis, Kaplan and Pelton target different envelopes; off-design efficiency/cavitation vary. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of turbines and operating envelopes, focusing on upper/lower pools, reversible units and round-trip efficiency. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Compare assumed efficiency maps beyond the best point. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.
steps.observation: 比較假想效率地圖而非只取最高效率點。
steps.observationEn: Compare assumed efficiency maps beyond the best point.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：所有水輪機可在相同水頭流量下等效互換。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: All turbines are interchangeable at equal head and flow.
steps.check: 提交可逆水輪pump的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。
steps.checkEn: Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for reversible turbine/pump.
